bias.label: Leaning down below 3,651-3,680; range 3,540-3,700, bigger trend down

event: Today 17:00 SAST: US consumer confidence. Wed 25 Nov 15:30 SAST: US October PCE inflation and Q3 GDP. Thu 26 Nov: Thanksgiving, US markets shut. Fri 27 Nov: early US close. Fed decision 9 Dec.

bullets.title: Bounce stalled
bullets.text: Kitco had spot gold at 3,619.30, down 0.4%, at 08:43 SAST, and no newer quote was found by 15:40 SAST (UNVERIFIED for now).

bullets.title: Sold from highs
bullets.text: Gold reached about 3,651-3,679 in early Asia (sources differ) and was pushed back to a 3,613 low.

bullets.title: Hike still expected
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about 93-95% odds of a 25 bp Fed hike on 9 December, with 50 bp near 5%.

bullets.title: Strong dollar
bullets.text: The dollar index rose about 0.5% to near 104.35 on Monday, close to its highest since April 2025.

bullets.title: Trend still down
bullets.text: Gold is near a 14-month low and far below its 50-day average, so rallies are bounces inside a downtrend.

bullets.title: Confidence at 17:00
bullets.text: US consumer confidence at 17:00 SAST today can move gold, so avoid entries in the minutes around it.

bullets.title: PCE on Wednesday
bullets.text: PCE and GDP at 15:30 SAST Wednesday are the big test, and Thanksgiving on Thursday will thin trading.
